# 盂蘭盆經疏折中疏

**ID:** X0378
**Volume:** X21
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／方等部疏
**Byline:** 清 靈耀撰
**Dynasty:** 清
**Date:** 1644–1911
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0378

## Contributors
- 靈耀 (A001987)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X378 in one fascicle is an early-Qīng commentary on the *Yúlánpén jīng* by [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) (Língyào Quánzhāng 靈耀全彰), the same Qīng-dynasty Tiāntái-school exegete responsible for the *Vajracchedikā* commentary [KR6c0081](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0081). The title 折中 ("mediating between extremes") signals the work's programmatic aim: to mediate between [宗密's "old commentary"](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) and [智旭's "new commentary"](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0372) (the *Xīnshū*), each of which [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) judges to be one-sidedly excellent.

**Abstract**

The preface is unusually candid in its diagnostic: "予閱盂蘭盆新舊二疏而歎夫先賢之未得兼長也" ("I have read the New and Old commentaries on the *Yúlánpén* and lamented that the earlier worthies did not manage to combine the strengths of both"). [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) then specifies the limits of each: "舊疏依經判釋，多約阿含事相，矩度井井，而未揭言外義趣" — Zōngmì's *Shū* is methodologically careful and follows the sūtra closely, drawing on *Āgama*-style narrative exposition, but does not unfold the "meaning beyond words" (*yánwài yìqù*); whereas "新疏妙辯縱橫，文義富麗，理觀圓極，而似不合現文" — Zhìxù's *Xīnshū* is dialectically masterful and richly written, doctrinally complete, but does not sit comfortably with the actual text. [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) then critiques [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s Tiāntái five-fold *xuányì*: in singling out *fǎgòng* 法供 ("Dharma-offering") as the title-meaning, [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) discards the binomial 佛說 ("the Buddha-said") that begins the title; in making *xiàocí* 孝慈 the tenet, he over-emphasizes circulation; in making the self-nature three-treasures the substance, he flattens the *yuánsān jiětuō* 圓三解脫 ("perfect threefold liberation") doctrine. [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80) proposes a *zhézhōng* 折中 ("mediating") commentary that supplements [宗密](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E5%AF%86) with selective deployment of Tiāntái categories, without adopting [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD)'s wholesale Tiāntái substitution. Composition window: [靈耀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9D%88%E8%80%80)'s active early-Qīng period, c. 1644–1700; no precise date is preserved.

Parent sūtra: [KR6i0364](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0364) (T685). Other commentaries: [KR6i0365](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0365) (Zōngmì T1792), Sòng cluster [KR6i0367](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0367)–[KR6i0371](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0371), Míng [KR6i0372](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0372) (智旭), Qīng [KR6i0374](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0374) (元奇 *Lüèshū* 略疏).
